Iono (Japanese: ナンジャモ Nanjyamo ) is an and who is the Gym Leader of Levincia's Gym, known officially as the Levincia Gym. She specializes in . She hands out the to s who defeat her.

==In the core series games==
===Role===
====Pokémon Scarlet and Violet====
Iono first appears when the player takes on her Gym Test, hosting a livestream titled "Where in Levincia is Mr. Walksabout?" While on stream, the player must find Director Clavell in various locations in the city. During the Gym battle, Iono is still shown to be streaming, and upon being defeated, Iono gives out the Electric Badge and the TM for Volt Switch.

After the player becomes Champion, Iono will still be at her Gym, anticipating a visit from Geeta for a Gym inspection. She is surprised to find the player carrying out the inspection instead, but will nonetheless readily challenge the player to a battle. Once defeated, she will request that the player tell Geeta what a sensation she was during the battle.

In The Indigo Disk, Iono can appear in the Blueberry Academy League Club as a special coach, and can be found speaking with Brassius, Larry, Tulip, Grusha, Clavell, or Salvatore. In her conversations with the , she reveals that she's taking this opportunity at the academy for her next stream, coming up with the title “Gym Leader Iono INFILTRATES this WEIRD ACADEMY! You won’t BELIEVE what she finds!” She then asks the player what her focus should be on, and if the player suggests the director, Cyrano, she describes how risky it could be to bring on a "snoozer guest", and how it'd be a "Top 10 Iono Betrayals moment..." If suggested in their initial meeting, Iono will report back on her second visit to the League Club that Cyrano's appearance made her viewer count rise dramatically due to his natural charisma. After beating her in a rematch, she will give the player the Iono Zone Case as a gift, which she describes as an "SSS-tier drop!" 

===Character===
 
Iono is a popular streamer and influencer from the Paldea region who runs the Iono Zone (Japanese: ドンナモンジャＴＶ Donnamonja TV) , where she showcases her work as a Gym Leader. She prioritizes viewer engagement and frequently collaborates with other popular figures, such as Tulip, though these collaborations can sometimes affect her self-esteem, and she doesn't like being rejected. Despite her overwhelming popularity making it difficult to go unnoticed, she reveals to Larry that she enjoys the attention. 

She is known for her unique habit of mixing languages, a quirk called "Iono-ese" by her and her fans. Her popularity has caught the attention of various significant figures, including Salvatore, who mentions her in his language class, and Grusha, who was a fan of her earlier content before she focused more on clicks and sponsorships. Iono no longer reads the comments on her streams due to negative feedback from certain fans. Salvatore, however, has a more positive relationship with her, affectionately calling her "Mademoiselle Magnemite". Her fans, known as the "Iono Hype Squad", often refer to her as "Miss Iono", while Tulip calls her "Nono". She's aware that many of her most loyal fans are students, including those attending Blueberry Academy. 

Often valuing her viewers' reactions more than winning battles, Iono sometimes regrets going too far for content, as seen in her conversation with Clavell at the League Club, though she brightened up when Clavell complimented the nickname "Mr. Walksabout" that she gave him on her stream. Interestingly, Iono notices that her viewer count spikes whenever she loses a battle, though she doesn't understand why. 

Iono is highly animated in her movements. She often shakes with clenched teeth in awkward or tense situations and, in battle, she continuously steps up and down in place. Her oversized jacket frequently conceals her hands, so actions like waving or holding a Poké Ball are done with her coat's arms. The dainty throwing style she uses in battle is the same as the one available to the player at the League Club and is shared with Poppy.

===Challenging the Levincia Gym===
Levincia Gym Leader: Iono

(AKA the Supercharged Streamer)

"This Electric-type user and hit streamer is adored by the young. Her viewers’ reactions are more important to her than victory in battle, and her Gym Test is one-of-a-kind. Be ready for anything!"

===Appearance===
 
Iono is a small, thin woman with long arms and legs. Her age is unclear, though she has been a streamer for several years. She has distinctive teal and pink hair that reaches below her knees, styled in two wide ponytails with "bulbs" at the ends and a short pink bang shaped like a ribbon. Her contact lenses feature a gradient of colors, and her unique eyelashes have purple, triangular segments. Her natural hair color might be black, suggested by her short, thin eyebrows. Iono's teeth are jagged and shark-like, which might be a nod to the design of popular virtual YouTuber characters in the real world. 

====Clothing and accessories====
Iono's outfit consists of an oversized yellow and black jacket with her logo on the front and stylized s on the sleeve straps. Beneath the jacket, she wears a silver bodysuit with a screw-like detail at the neck and a black textured outfit underneath, extending to her thighs. Her shoes, matching the bodysuit in color, have high heels and a yellow outsole, with a protruding "screw". All her clothing items feature a hexagonal pattern. She also sports a black strap on her left thigh with gray text.

Two "fancy shmancy" with the intent to tease the reveal of her partner Pokémon, , just two days later in Meet Bellibolt. An announcement of her reveal was made just one day prior, with the Japanese account including a silhouetted tease of her design. In the videos, she dances around animatedly, spouts her usual catchphrases, and baits the audience to catch the full reveal, letting slip that she chose to do so to rack up the on her follow-up.

Her voice in these reveals went uncredited for a whole year until the release of Breathe In, which, in re-using audio from this animation for a short cameo featuring Iono, confirms her voice actress here was Fairouz Ai. 
 

===Pokémon: Path to the Peak===
 ]]
A card featuring Iono, specifically Iono (Paldea Evolved 185), appeared in Internationals, used as part of Edgar Troy's strategy.
 

===Biri-Biri===
 ]]
Iono briefly appeared as a silhouette alongside the other Paldea Gym Leaders in the music video for Biri-Biri.
 

==In the manga==
===Let's Play the Pokémon Card Game!===
 
Monjana (Japanese: ﻿もんじゃな Monjana), a cross-canon counterpart of Iono, appeared in the Scarlet & Violet arc of Let's Play the Pokémon Card Game!, where she battles against the protagonists. Her deck is themed around Pokémon, such as and , and often mentions how lucky she is at the game. Monjana's personality appears to be similar to that of Iono's in , as she maintains a thoroughly smug attitude throughout both of her battles, though her design is radically different. The -shaped hairclips have been replaced with Master Balls, and her hair now curves below her face in the shape of lightning bolts. Additionally, she now has an actual ribbon in her hair, as opposed to having her hair styled like a ribbon above her fringe.
 
Her design is far simpler in this manga; her sharp teeth have been removed in favor of a single fang, with further simplifications made to her boots and singular thigh high, the latter of which was removed. Her jacket now resembles a in spite of it not making an appearance in Monjana's deck during the chapter she is in, but its expression on the jacket shifts depending on Monjana's own personality for comedic effect.
 

===Pocket Monsters===
 
 
Iono briefly appeared in a cameo in HZM03.
 
===Pokémon Adventures===
 
Iono debuted in Decisive! The Battle in the Sky!!. She was first seen in Levincia, where she received a challenge from and . Once both challengers successfully completed their Gym Tests, Iono faced Scarlet in a Gym battle first. Scarlet easily took down Iono's first two Pokémon and sent out her , which she taught the move as a countermeasure for when Iono stallized her final Pokémon. Iono boasted that her was invincible, as it possessed the Ability, making moves useless against it.

Scarlet eventually emerged victorious while managing to prevent Iono from using Terastallization, but when Nemona questioned her strategic decisions during the match, Scarlet revealed it was intentional. Just before they battled, Iono requested that Scarlet help create a battle that would get lots of views. As compensation, Scarlet asked to have an all-you-can-eat buffet at every food stall in Levincia to make up for Iono having no information on the treasures of ruin. Afterward, Iono called Nemona over to have their Gym battle.

===Paldea Evolved===
 
Iono was introduced as a in the Pokémon Trading Card Game during the English Scarlet & Violet Series (the Japanese Scarlet & Violet Era). It was first released in the Japanese expansion and the English expansion. An version and a version of the card were released in the same sets. The card makes both players return their hand to the bottom of their deck, and draw a new hand consisting of as many cards as they have s remaining.

==Merchandise==
===Pokémon Trading Card Game===
Iono has had a variety of merchandise released exclusively for the Pokémon Trading Card Game.
====Iono====
Deck Boxes, Sleeves and Dividers known as Iono, drawn by Tika Matsuno. The merchandise was released on April 14, 2023.

 

==== Iono Zone====
Sleeves known as Iono Zone, released on December 1, 2023, are based on the billboard art of Iono found in Levincia.

 

====Shiny Treasure ex special set====
Deck Boxes, Sleeves and a mat were released through the Iono exclusively in Taiwan and Hong Kong on December 22nd, 2023, with art drawn by kirisAki. It features Iono and her in Levincia.

 

==== Iono Premium Tournament Collection====
A collection known as the Iono Premium Tournament Collection was released exclusively in the west for $39.99 on the Pokémon Center website. It contained a unique full-art foil Supporter card featuring Iono, as well as 65 Sleeves and a deck box featuring the same artwork drawn by Tika Matsuno for the Iono series of TCG merchandise, which was exclusive to Japan until this release. In addition, it contained a large metallic coin featuring Iono's artwork from Pokémon Scarlet and Violet, as well as six TCG Booster packs, ranging from Lost Origin, Scarlet & Violet, Obsidian Flames, Paradox Rift and Temporal Forces. Two additional coins, as well as dice colored yellow and pink are also a part of the collection.

The three copies of the Regular Iono card from Paldea Evolved included in the collection are notably stamped with an Iono Zone logo. 

North America: January 2024 

 

===Kotobukiya ArtFX J Figure===
Iono and her partner Pokémon, Bellibolt, were released as a Kotobukiya ArtFX J Figure in Japan, North America and the United Kingdom through the Pokemon Center. The stand features her logo from the Iono Zone. It features artwork drawn by Naoki Saito. 

Japan: June 12, 2023

 

===Paldea Tours===
A jacket based on Iono's from Pokémon Scarlet & Violet was released as part of the Paldea Tours line on the Pokémon Center in Japan.

Japan: April 13, 2023 

 

===Trainers Line===
Iono and her partner Pokémon, Bellibolt, were included as part of the Paldea wave of characters added to the Trainers Line, and released through the Pokémon Center in Japan. It features artwork drawn by Megumi Mizutani. 

Japan: September 14, 2023

 

=== Iono Apparel===
Apparel based on Iono's appearance in Pokémon Scarlet and Violet were released on the Pokémon Center on September 15th, 2023 in Japan.

Japan: September 15, 2023 

 

===Scale World: Paldea Region===
Iono and her partner Pokémon, Bellibolt, were included as part of the Paldea Region wave of characters, as a figure added to the Scale World line in Japan.

Japan: December 31, 2023 

 

===Miniature Torso Figures===
Iono and her partner Pokémon, , were included alongside other Trainers from Galar and Paldea as part of the Miniature Torso Figures line, released through the Pokémon Center in Japan. Small figures of Iono's jacket and -shaped hairclips could be purchased alongside an acrylic stand of Bellibolt.

Japan: February 22, 2024 

 

===Badges of Paldea===
Iono's Gym Badge, the Electric Badge, was featured as a part of the Badges of Paldea line, sold exclusively in Japan. It was one of eight Gym Badges of Paldea in one of three made-to-order framed sets of Gym Badges based on the main plotlines in Pokémon Scarlet and Violet; Victory Road, the Path of Legends, and ★ Starfall Street ★, expected to ship in July of 2024. Each set retailed at ¥26,400. 

Japan: Between February 22, 2024 and March 25th, 2024
